mapper.sql: FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.department_id=e.department_id WHERE e.employment_status <> 'DEPARTED' AND INSTR(e.display_name, #{name}) > 0 AND d.department_code = #{departmentId} AND INSTR(e.duty_summary, #{task}) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT e.employee_code AS employeeId, e.display_name AS displayName, d.department_code AS departmentCode, e.job_title AS jobTitle, e.company_email AS companyEmail, e.extension_no AS extensionNo
ORDER BY NLSSORT(e.display_name, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY'),d.department_code, e.employee_code OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT department_code AS departmentCode, department_name AS departmentName FROM department WHERE active_yn='Y' ORDER BY department_code
SELECT d.department_code AS departmentCode,e.employment_status AS status FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.department_id=e.department_id WHERE e.employee_code=#{id}
SELECT employee_code FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_code,display_name,department_id,job_title,company_email,extension_no,duty_summary,employment_status) SELECT #{employeeId},#{displayName},department_id,#{jobTitle},#{companyEmail},#{extensionNo},#{task},'ACTIVE' FROM department WHERE department_code=#{departmentId} AND active_yn='Y'
mapper.update:
UPDATE employee SET
department_id=(SELECT department_id FROM department WHERE department_code=#{department} AND active_yn='Y') employment_status=#{status}, departed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='DEPARTED' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END
WHERE employee_code=#{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM department WHERE department_code=#{department} AND active_yn='Y')
